name: document-extraction-agent
description: Pulls structured fields out of long contracts, where every field carries the verbatim span it came from — and a field whose evidence is not in the document is deleted, not flagged.

scripts.test: tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && ls dist-test/*.test.js >/dev/null && node --test dist-test/*.test.js
scripts.sample: npm run build --silent && node -e "const {sampleRun}=await import(\"./dist/sample.js\");const {report}=await import(\"./dist/report.js\");console.log(report(await sampleRun()))" --input-type=module
